planets.name: TOI-5788 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5788 with a 6.34-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-5788 b was found in 2026 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-5788. Its orbit and size follow Lakeland et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname LAKELAND_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2026, disc_facility Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS), sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 6.340758, pl_radj 0.13631926, pl_bmassj 0.01170443

quotes.title: TOI-5788
quotes.card: Two exoplanets orbit it, designated as TOI-5788 b and TOI-5788 c, where the former is classified as a rocky planet and the latter is a mini-Neptune.
